item.title: Series of 5 fully grown trees with low hanging branches at 300-302 Brixton road SW9., 13th August
item.description:
I like to report a series of 5 fully grown trees with low hanging branches. The trees are located at 300-302 Brixton road SW9. Every time a bus passes the trees the branches collide against the bus making a horrendous noise. I work across the road from where the trees are located and recently saw a man turn up to address this issue he had a suction device that he put against the low hanging branches I assume to clip them. This method simply doesn't work the branches are still hitting the sides of the buses and still making a loud noise. Please can the the branches be cut back by a team of professional tree cutters who would actually saw back the branches. This issue has been ongoing for over six months.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 296-298, Brixton Road, Brixton, Greater London

item.title: Cones on road to reserve parking place, 13th August
item.description:
Recently a new resident moved into number 7 Ruxley Close, DA14 5LS. This property is situated on a corner with road and footpath to the front and side. Parking is extremely limited in Ruxley Close and has always been on a first come first served basis with residents accepting this arrangement. As a result, many residents have turned their front gardens into parking for their vehicles. About three weeks ago the new resident moved into the property mentioned above. On the night prior to him moving in he placed a note on another resident’s car that was parked to the side of his property telling her that she could no longer park there as he needed the space to park his delivery van. On the following day, the new resident arrived with an exceptionally large Mercedes box van and parked in the space he had claimed, he then placed two large traffic cones at the front and rear of his van. The van is usually parked between these cones between 23:00 and 15:00 when he goes to work, the cones are then placed back in the road to prevent anyone parking there, this vehicle takes up around two car spaces. He also has a small 15cwt van which is parked on the pavement at the corner of his house which hinders pedestrians and has also prevented the refuse collection vehicle from entering the close therefore collections have been missed. Fortunately, there has been no need for emergency vehicles to get into the close during this time although there are a number of elderly and frail residents in the close that at times need emergency assistance. The point is that there are residents and visitors that are unable to park even when he is not at home and the van is not there because he has claimed parking space by obstructing the road. Could you please investigate this complaint for myself and other residents as we consider this to be extremely inconsiderate and probably illegal. The person concerned can be intimidating and aggressive so there is no other course of action other than to request your assistance
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Ruxley Close, North Cray, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Repeated Flytippibg outside collection days at this spot., 13th August
item.description:
There is consistent fly tipping of domestic rubbish outside 6 & 8 Cranley Gardens SW7. This photograph was taken at 8:30 pm on Thursday. 13th of August. Fly tipping happened this week on Monday evening despite that being a K&C rubbish collection in the morning and again it has happened today with rubbish being put out despite the K&C rubbish collection having happened this morning. This is attracting other people to add rubbish to it as well as litter from passes by. This is unacceptable and it stays out overnight and foxes and birds terrorist pieces creating work for The road sweepers and also slip hazards for pedestrians. Please can you find these people as they are regular offenders. The two addresses are social housing and other tenants are getting fed up with this happens oustside their front doors. Please act.
